job: Show one-time recovery codes once, with copy and download.
purpose: A sunken card holding a two-column grid of codes, a title with Copy all and Download buttons, and a warning line. Copy all and Download use the codes not marked data-used, one per line; Download makes a text file through a Blob URL. Without script the buttons are hidden and the codes stay selectable text.
useWhen: Two-step sign-in has just been set up and the person must save backup codes.
A set of codes is shown with some already used.

avoidWhen.when: One secret that is shown and hidden.

states.name: used
states.how: data-used on the fd-codes-item; struck through and left out of copy and download

states.name: ready
states.how: data-ready on the root once the script has run; the buttons show then

variants.useWhen: The name of the downloaded file.

parts.role: Holds the copy and download buttons.
One code, in a code element.

keyboard.does: On Copy all or Download, runs it.
